claims.assertion: Mari Swa says forced reincarnation may be experienced by some souls but not others, depending on their beliefs and what they manifest.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She explicitly presents this as her opinion and personal framework.

claims.assertion: Mari also argues that controllers shape collective beliefs and perceptions, which can lead people to accept reincarnation-related belief systems.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: This is her conspiratorial explanation of perceived coercion.
